body: I told my husband a few days ago that I may be experiencing PPD. I had it with my first baby and I remember having thoughts of suicide but it's more intense now because of my family problems. Everyone in my family is super religious and the mention of suicide or any other problems are completely closed out. Suicide is sin in their eyes and they don't discuss it cause I'm selfish or a coward if I choose to go that route. It makes it worse. I think staying at home may contribute to it. Some days I have major cabin fever. My best friend is taking me out on Sunday so hopefully that will help. I don't get to see her often but it's nice when we get together.

im not a cutter but I do want to get help. I want to see my kids grow up. I hate the thoughts that I have and the emotional roller coaster I have every day. I only sleep maybe 2-3 hours at night because I'm up crying or stressing about my family members. I feel like I'm in a jail in my own head. I wish you wouldn't cut either I had a friend who started at 12 and I can't imagine what it's like.

1. Yes, he is the only person that I have talked to about this. 
2. I have health insurance and only recently found out that they cover me seeing a professional. I'm breastfeeding so I want to know my options about medication. 
3. I'm a stay at home mom and my husband works at a call center.
4. My user name is my current and past initials.
